title: URL structure decoding (manual)
notes: Owned by batch p1-G03-1 (P064 url_unwrap cond 2: no automated call to dfir.blog or any Unfurl service, manual link only). dfir.blog/unfurl/ now redirects (301) to hindsig.ht/unfurl/, whose page reads ?url= and sends it to the author's cloud function: opening the link discloses the URL (non-clickable at TLP:AMBER and above).

links.label: Unfurl (URL structure decoder)
links.notes: Public web UI of the open-source Unfurl project (Apache-2.0); reads ?url= from the address bar. Opening it sends the URL to the Unfurl service: never auto-opened, and URLs carrying recipient tokens should be unwrapped/redacted with url_unwrap first.
